profile_text.body:
SlidesAI is a web-based tool that converts text inputs, including notes, documents, PDFs, and prompts, into presentation slides. The company describes its product as working across Google Slides, PowerPoint, the ChatGPT interface, and its own web app. It positions itself as useful for teachers building lecture slides, students turning research notes into thesis presentations, and professionals who need polished decks quickly.

The core product, also called SlidesAI, is categorized as a presentation generation tool and is tracked on theworldofai.org under that category. The company's site includes a comparison of SlidesAI against Gamma, Canva, Plus AI, and Presentations.ai across presentation-building capabilities, with pricing referenced at entry-level paid individual plan rates on month-to-month billing in USD, though the site notes that features and pricing change frequently.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
